# DevFn

> Trusted local profiles, process and Compose lifecycle, port leases, readiness, and localhost routes.

## Documentation

- [Configuration](/docs/configuration) — Declare project identity, ports, processes, Compose services, and profiles.
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Initialize, trust, inspect, and start a local profile.
- [DevFn](/docs) — Trusted lifecycle orchestration for local development.
- [Lifecycle and diagnostics](/docs/lifecycle) — Start, inspect, stop, and recover one worktree instance.
- [Migrating a project](/docs/migration) — Adopt DevFn while preserving existing startup and data paths.
- [Packages](/docs/packages) — Map DevFn's eight packages to their responsibilities.
- [Ports and localhost routes](/docs/ports-and-proxy) — Allocate per-worktree ports and publish concrete local URLs.
- [Processes and Compose](/docs/processes-and-compose) — Run native applications and worktree-scoped infrastructure.
- [@devfn/cli](/docs/reference/cli) — Source package guide for @devfn/cli.

- [Reference](/docs/reference) — DevFn configuration, security, migration, and package guides.
- [Migration guide](/docs/reference/migration) — Adopt DevFn without losing existing scripts, outputs, or Compose data.
- [@devfn/ports](/docs/reference/ports) — Source package guide for @devfn/ports.

- [@devfn/testing](/docs/reference/testing) — Source package guide for @devfn/testing.
- [Trust and secret handling](/docs/security) — Review manifests, isolate secrets, and confirm public exposure.
